text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened on the way back from an outing with Epiphaneia—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh~... The paint on the butcher shop's sign has completely peeled off.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It had so much history and character, it really was a great sign, but... hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here?
Is something wrong with the sign?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I heard talk that they wanted to fix up the old signboard!
The question is, how should we go about
renovating it, though—"

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Keeper
text_block_list.text: Decided! Since we're doing this, let's make a big, flashy new signboard!

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Keeper
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it look cool and spell out "NIKUYA" in English!
We can make it flash bright with neon lights!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...?
The neon lights are pretty, after all... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Replacing things with new ones is good for feng shui!
Just need one more little push... mmmh~!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Mm? ...Hey, you two!
Got a second?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What do you really want to do with the sign?
You have an idea, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. Frankly, I think it's a waste to just aim for cheap flashiness. A sign is meant to carry the soul of the shop, after all."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking, maybe we could turn the sign northwest to boost our luck!
Though doing such major construction might be tough~!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Got it loud and clear! Then I'll pour my soul
into the sign! Facing northwest it goes!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Misteeeer!
Leave the sign to meee!!

text_block_list.name: Logo & Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
First, the design! The soul of a butcher is meat!
Let's go super meaty with steak!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that looks delicious.
The specialty here is minced meat cutlets, though—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then let's get that too! And let's add a hamburger steak and fried chicken!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san, hold on a second...!
Let's stick to just one dish with true soul in it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then let's figure out the sign's direction first!
It's facing northwest, so... let's put it on the side of the shop!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "How's that! Turned out pretty good now, didn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, the sign's gotta face front!
Otherwise, the flow of qi will get all topsy-turvy!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Put the signboard right in front, bam! Along with good qi, tons of customers will come pouring in! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And for the design, I want to keep Feng Shui in mind too!
To absorb positive energy,
it'd be best if it expressed a smile☆

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, what if we draw the shopkeeper smiling...?
To express their passion for serving delicious meat—"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. One way or another,
our hands are still moving, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that fine, then?!
Your heart's telling you to do it, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! With the power of feng shui,
business is gonna be booming!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to be a great signboard for us too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Logo-san! About the shopkeeper's face!
I want to make it pop out and look 3D!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And if your gaze is directed toward the northwest, it's perfect!
We can't change the direction of the sign, but this will let the bright qi flow in!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, we're really hitting our stride now!
Let's keep going full steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Make the minced meat cutlet big and juicy—make it look appetizing.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
And I'll sketch a portrait of the shopkeeper on the side.
...Yeah, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Across the street is a fishmonger...
I'll need to sort out the compatibility.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Logo-san, do you think you could paint a cutting board on the sign? By putting wood in between, I want to create harmony!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Woah, this signboard is super cute!
Gonna take a picture! Wait, it smells so good too!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
That looks good... Um, excuse me!
Could I please get four menchi-katsu?

text_block_list.name: Butcher Shop Keeper
text_block_list.text: Coming right up! Haha, we're open till tonight! Thanks, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm just glad far more
good qi flowed in than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined things would go so well...
It's all thanks to you leading the way, Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I just did whatever I wanted!
And this is the result of destiny pushing me forward!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"All we gotta do is keep believing and moving forward.
Just with that, we're invincible!"
choice_data_list: So, what should we strive toward next?
I could learn a thing or two from that confidence!
I could learn a thing or two from that confidence!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"All we gotta do is keep believing and moving forward.
Just with that, we're invincible!"
choice_data_list: So, what should we strive toward next?
I could learn a thing or two from that confidence!
I could learn a thing or two from that confidence!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course...
I wanna eat my fill of minced meat cutlets!

text_block_list.name: Rickey & Logo
text_block_list.text:
I'm in favor of that!
I agree!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eating minced meat cutlets while admiring the sign
they put so much love into was truly exceptional.
Before they knew it, everyone had big smiles on their faces!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?
'Us' includes you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes telling me to stop...
Your voice always reaches me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Just follow the voice of destiny with confidence!
Keep up the good work going forward!
